text_block_list.text:
After our day out, Уиннинг Тикит and I
return to
the academy.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Finished! That was fun, wasn't it,
Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит
choice_data_list: Did you have a nice break?

text_block_list.text: Yeah! I feel so refreshed! All revitalized!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I forgot about all my little worries!
Though I
usually forget most things
anyway!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Look—over there, in front of the
gate...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Sniffle...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
What's wrong, Spe? Something troubling
you?
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Oh, Tickezo.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
I heard that the results of the academic
skill test
were up, so I came to look...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: And I gotta take extra classes!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Ohhh, that test we did a while back...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Sigh... I'll have to ask Suzuka to help me study again.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: I get it! I get you, Spe!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
When you think you're finally done with
studying,
extra classes come outta
nowhere!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Waaahhh! It's so tough, right?! Like life's
got it in
for you!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
But I've got this! I'll solve your worries in
one
swoop!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: You will?
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Just come with me! Trainer, you too!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Huh? Where are we going?
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Here we are! The river, Spe!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Uh-huh... The river, okay...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
You know how a river gets this big? It's
'cause lots
of little streams from the
mountains come
together, bit by bit!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: So if we all work together, we'll be really strong too! Isn't that the most inspiring thing ever?!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Okay, next!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Ah, wait!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Look, Spe! It's the park!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Yes, the park... Okay.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Look! There's some little Umamusume
playing tag!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Maybe they're dreaming of the Derby
too!
Yeaaah! Good luck, li'l ones!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Okay, next!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: H-hold on a sec!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
The shrine, Spe! The scenery from here
is—
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Um, I don't mind coming to the shrine,
but what is
this all about?
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Huh? About being moved, to your very
core, of
course!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Just by seeing all these different sights,
you felt
all kinds of emotions, right?
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I know you're disappointed and upset
about the
extra classes, but...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
If you look ahead, there are all these
touching
things out there! They'll make
your everyday
concerns fly right out of
the window!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Ohh, this will get rid of my concerns!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
So let's experience lots of touching
things, chuck
your worries out the
window, and move on!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
See? If you compare your troubles to
what's going
on here, don't they seem
itsy-bitsy?
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
There are so many buildings and
people... Yeah,
it is kinda making me
feel like my concerns are
small!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Compared to the whole wide city, extra
classes
are just a tiny speck on a peanut!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Hehe! Glad to see you're feeling better!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Ping!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Oh, a message?
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
What? No waaay! I got extra classes
too?!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Nooo! I'll have less time for training and
less time
to have fun!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит
choice_data_list: It's no big deal! Just a speck on a peanut!
Need to refresh yourself one more time?

text_block_list.text:
Nooo! I'll have less time for training and
less time
to have fun!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит
choice_data_list: It's no big deal! Just a speck on a peanut!
Need to refresh yourself one more time?

text_block_list.text: That's soooo mean! It is a big deal!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Huh?! What about my "itsy-bitsy
troubles"?!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, extra classes are just tiny
little
things, remember? We'll get
through them
together!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Aaahhhh! What a dependable friend!
Thanks so
much, Speee!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Waaahhh! Thanks so muuuuch! I sure do
need
iiiiit!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Hey, um, I'll stick with you, so let's go
around
looking for more inspiring things!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Speee! You're an angel!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
All right, full speed to emotional
inspiration!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
So we continue our walk, visiting various
inspiring
locations, until Уиннинг Тикит
starts to feel a
little better.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Somehow getting comforted by the
person she
was consoling just a few
moments ago, Winning
Ticket finds the
determination to take extra
classes.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
